# NCT05155033 
 
Status: RECRUITING | Phase: PHASE2 | Study Type: INTERVENTIONAL | Sponsor: National Cancer Institute (NCI) 
 
Title: Phase II Trial of Combination Anti-PD-1 and Aldesleukin for Metastatic Melanoma and Renal Cell Carcinoma 
Target Enrollment: 78 
Eligible Ages: 18 Years to 120 Years 
Start Date: 2022-08-18 | Completion Date: 2031-09-01 
Source: ClinicalTrials.gov 
 
## Conditions (ClinicalTrials.gov) 
- Metastatic Melanoma 
- Advanced Locoregional Melanoma 
- Metastatic Renal Cell Carcinoma 
- Clear Cell Histology 
 
## Interventions (ClinicalTrials.gov) 
- Pembrolizumab *(DRUG)* 
- Aldesleukin *(DRUG)* 
 
## Summary (ClinicalTrials.gov) 
 
Background:

Aldesleukin is used to treat metastatic or advanced melanoma and renal cell carcinoma. Pembrolizumab is used to treat many cancers including melanoma...
